## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Esoteric scripture by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) on the **One-Syllable Wondrous Buddha-Crown** practice — companion to [KR6j0124](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0124) (T950) and the wider Buddha-Crown / *uṣṇīṣa* corpus.

**Abstract**

The text presents an elaborated form of the One-Syllable Buddha-Crown practice with the additional epithet *qítè* ("wondrous, marvellous"), emphasizing the practice's powerful soteriological efficacy. The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Cháng'ān period (746–774).
